verdict.rationale: Numeral explicitly tracks per-jurisdiction economic thresholds with current sales and transaction counts, continually monitors exposure across US and global jurisdictions, and proactively alerts founders when they cross nexus in new jurisdictions — directly matching the 'before, not after' framing. This is corroborated across marketing, pricing, and MCP tooling docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that alerts actually fire before threshold-crossing (only vendor docs available), and no detail on lead-time or alert granularity.
